name: travelos
description: A modern Travel Agency Operations Management SaaS platform.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @travelos/api" "npm run dev -w @travelos/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @travelos/shared && npm run build -w @travelos/api && npm run build -w @travelos/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @travelos/api && npm run lint -w @travelos/web
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:create && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
